sloka: आसेदतुः च तत् रक्षः तौ उभौ प्रमुखे स्थितम् ।विवृद्धम् अ-शिरो ग्रीवम् कबंधम् उदरे मुखम् ॥३-६९-२७॥
transliteration: āsedatuḥ ca tat rakṣaḥ tau ubhau pramukhe sthitam ।vivṛddham a-śiro grīvam kabaṁdham udare mukham ॥3-69-27॥

translations.english: Then both the brothers saw a very tall figure with a trunk that stood facing them. He had neither neck nor head. His face was in the stomach.
